name: Finish Plus

features.text: Great for metallic, black, red and deep-tone paints.
Use by hand, machine, or orbital buffer.
Leaves a high shine and long lasting protection

description: A very thick, purple, cream finish wax for all painted surfaces (clearcoat and conventional). It fills scratches and removes swirls, while leaving an amazing gloss.
application: Hand Use: Apply Finish Plus™ with a wax applicator, or clean cloth, using an overlapping circular motion. Allow product to dry completely. After product is completely dry, wipe off with a clean towel, or polish with an orbital buffer. Machine Use: For best results, use an all-wool finish pad or foam pad.
review: Has a Performance Ratings section: Abrasiveness - 2 Gloss - 8 Durability - 6
